notes:
Summary: Vyra builds a real-time bidding and personalization engine for mobile ad flows. Primary constraint is single-digit to low-double-digit ms tail latency (p95/p99) on inference for short-chat/personalization prompts under variable QPS (burst to 15k QPS for peak campaigns). Extremely cost sensitive — wants to understand token-level economics and how batching + prefix/KV caching + quantization reduce $/req without breaking model quality. CRM notes below — fragments/quotes from calls.

- "On tail latency we can tolerate 10-15ms for core reranking, but must keep p99 < 40ms when bursting" — VP Eng (call).
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: quantization profiles per model family, automated batching rules, cache TTL heuristics.
- Wants a perf bench plan: 1) baseline current model (FP16) 2) 8-bit/quantized variants 3) with+without prefix cache 4) with batching strategy tuned to latency SLOs.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 1yr, optional customer-managed KMS. Data residency requirement: NA region only for first phase.
- Quote: "If Redwood can prove 30-40% per-request cost reduction with no >1% quality regression we have a clear path to Dedicated".
workload_requirements: Latency: p95 target 12ms for rerank, p99 <40ms under bursts. Throughput: baseline 3k QPS with spikes to 15k. Cost sensitivity: aiming to reduce current $/req by 30% via batching/caching/quantization. Model preferences: open Llama2-style variants and commercially compatible weights; fallback routing for high load. Need measurable perf benchmarks (latency and token-cost), reproducible harness.
poc_success_criteria: <15ms p95 for core reranker under steady-state 3k QPS
>=30% reduction in token cost vs current baseline
quality regression <1% on offline eval set

integration_notes: Preference for Dedicated pool in NA with canary routing to hosted for fallback. VPC peering required. Wants per-token cost telemetry accessible in Console. Plan to test KMS envelope for keys. SSO integration timeline: 2 weeks.
